authority: Synthetic experimental observations; not a Vault grounding source or human acceptance.

cases.description: An entirely empty package makes no domain adequacy claim.
A version may exist without an editorial text grouping.
A nonempty half-open interval resolves to one region.
Two separated segments form ONE target, available to an annotation.
All policy preserves three distinct overlapping occurrences.
Ambiguity is valid and retains all candidates but accepts none.
An annotation can keep a quotation absent from this version.
Empty content has a valid point at zero.
Astral symbols count once; combining marks remain separately addressable.
Canonically related Unicode spellings remain different literal content.
A syntactically plausible hash must equal exact UTF-8 content.
A selection version reference must resolve.
A point cannot exceed the code-point length.
JSON true is not a valid integer coordinate.
Correct bounds do not excuse a nonliteral segment quote.
Empty content cannot contain a nonempty interval.
Adjacent segments are allowed and retain their segmentation.
One ranges selector cannot overlap its own segments.
Declaring a text requires an explicit continuity claim.
Overlapping version memberships express distinct attributed criteria.
A continuity claim must articulate a nonempty grouping policy.
An editorial continuity claim must reference an actual agent.
Diamond ancestry is allowed and does not establish text continuity.
Only acyclic version ancestry is valid.
Equal content and hashes do not collapse distinct version records.
Crossing extents across attributed readings and relation cycles are allowed.
The same crossing intervals are invalid as roots of one reading.
Parent and child may assert the exact same nonempty extent.
Equal extents do not make a cycle in parent edges valid.
A child extending past its parent fails containment.
One target with multiple segments is still unsuitable for a reading node.
An absent annotation target cannot become a reading-node interval.
Several accepted targets do not identify one reading-node interval.
A relation concept is not a node type even though its ID resolves.
A declared reading must contain at least one node.
IDs are globally unique across registries.
The closed package shape rejects unknown fields.
Adjacent literal prefix picks the final overlapping occurrence.
Distinct IDs and conflicting annotation bodies remain valid assertions by people.
Adjacent segments form a contiguous node interval without erasing their boundary.
A resolved point remains an invalid reading-node target.
Object keys, registries, parent sets, and continuity membership reorder freely.
Competing readings are records, not an ordered priority list.
Reordering node records preserves explicit hierarchy edges.
Equal resolved extents do not erase selector-kind identity.
One versus all remains distinct even when the quote occurs once.
A split into adjacent segments is preserved by canonical comparison.
Alpha-renaming changes record identity despite equal target extents.
A different responsible editor changes the continuity claim.
Editorial grouping criteria are substantive canonical data.
Canonical JSON comparison does not normalize Unicode content.
Membership ordering cannot rewrite a version.
A changed text is admitted as a new version with a new ID.
A faithful new hash does not permit changing content under the old ID.
Reused version ancestry is frozen even when replacement ancestry is acyclic.
An absent later record is outside rewrite detection.
Revision checks validate package hash fidelity first.
Explicit editorial continuity connects immutable versions without silently moving annotations.
A source range supplies its literal quote for a proposed target.
Quote reanchoring retains the literal adjacent prefix and suffix.
Multiple target matches produce an unaccepted ambiguous proposal.
A missing target quotation produces an unaccepted absent proposal.
Point migration requires a policy outside this experiment.
Multi-segment target migration is explicitly unsupported.
Even contiguous adjacent segments exceed the one-segment reanchoring contract.
Version ancestry alone does not authorize editorial continuity.
An ambiguous source cannot be reanchored; source warnings are not duplicated by this operation.
Quote/all stays intentional plurality when one source occurrence becomes two target occurrences.

fingerprint_policy: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with checkout CRLF/CR normalized to LF; model content is unchanged.
